Theme

Latin word

explicō

explicō, explicāre, explicāvī, explicātum

verb, first conjugation

explain, set out (literally, unfold)

In this lexicon

  • explain

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Off. 1.16: potest et vidēre et explicāre ratiōnem; Traupman 26, 29

Examples

  • sī nēmō ex mē quaerat, sciō; sī quaerentī explicāre velim, nesciō

    if nobody asks me, I know; if I want to explain it to someone who asks, I don’tAug. Conf. 11.14.17

    In the entry for explain

  • Inter edendum pater quid eō diē vīsūrī essent explicāvit

    Over breakfast Dad explained what they were going to see that dayLibellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus

    In the entry for explain

  • Tum pater docuit nōmen illud, ā rēge Francōrum antīquō ductum, 'pugnā clārum' significāre.

    Then Dad explained that the name, which comes from an old king of the Franks, means “famous in battle”.Libellus V, Lisbōna: castellum et ōceanārium
